event_name: Date 29 April 2018 Time 19:52 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 41 & 42) and heard from the drivers and team representative, have considered the following matter and hereby determine the following
fact: Car 3 collided with car 33 at turn 20
offence: Causing a collision in breach of Article 2d of Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code
penalty: Reprimand This is the driver's 1st reprimand of the current season
reason: The Stewards heard from Daniel Ricciardo, the driver of car 3, Max Verstappen, the driver of car 33 and the team representative. Both drivers contributed to the collision. The driver of car 33 made two moves, both of which were relatively minor. The driver of car 3 admitted he left his move to overtake on the left, too late. It was obvious to the stewards that although the incident had its origins in the moves by car 33, the driver of car 3 also contributed to the incident. Both drivers expressed regret about their respective contributions to the incident, during the Stewards' hearing. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
